status: DRAFT - not locked, not authorized. Nothing runs from this file without an owner authorization (budget.md).

roster.rule: Pinned at lock via PlumMe AUTO for the solve role; member_2 must have an independence_key different from Luna's. The canonical_model_id and independence_key of every member are written into the lock. Every retry stays on the pinned model (sticky). A replacement is logged as ROSTER_CHANGE and makes the affected rows INFRA_IDENTITY.
roster.small_model_exclusion: AUTHOR/solve steps exclude models of 12B or less and the nemotron-lightning/nano class (PlumMe small_model_reason), as in OGI-013 REPAIR-1 R5
roster.scaling: with M members: one S arm per member; E round-robin over all M; budget.md scales linearly in M

T.what: organized team: CherryMe Brother Mode, blind parallel first answers, cross-lineage critique, replies, revision
T.driver: runners/fs_org_driver.py run_episode(task, work, hook, arm='T', n_solvers=2, max_rounds=3)
T.final_answer: fs_org_driver.final_answer: CONSENSUS, else UNRESOLVED_PRIMARY_RETAINED (never a vote, never order luck)
T.learning: EVAL-001/003: LearningHook(apply=False). Nothing is retrieved or injected, but captures are recorded and serve as EVAL-002 seeding. EVAL-002: see the applied/control arms

E.what: compute-matched non-collaborative control: the same roster members, independent drafts, no critique, no exchange, no revision
E.k: k = the number of provider calls T made on that task (at least 2), read from T's PlumMe receipts; drafts alternate round-robin over the roster, Luna first

selection.D1_tau2: step-level self-consistency: at each agent step, k_step independent proposals (k_step = T's dispatches for that step, at least 2); the plurality action is executed, ties go to the earliest proposal
selection.D2_D3_code: every draft is run against the task's VISIBLE tests (the same ones T can run); the draft passing the most wins, ties go to the earliest
selection.D4_math: plurality of the normalized final answers (math-verify equivalence classes), ties go to the earliest
selection.D5_claims: plurality of the claim verdict, ties go to the earliest

V.what: majority-vote control (EVAL-003 only): computed from E's drafts at no extra provider cost

selection.D2_D3_code: behavioral plurality: drafts are clustered by their output signature on the visible test inputs; one draft from the largest cluster wins, ties go to the earliest
selection.D4_math: identical to E's plurality rule; V is reported separately only for code

S.what: each roster member alone (one arm per member: S_luna, S_member_2)
S.calls: single episode with the member's own tool loop when the domain has one (tau2, code with visible tests), otherwise one call
S.note: S_luna and L coincide whenever Luna is a roster member. It is run once and reported under both labels.

L.what: Luna alone through the subscription route (INCLUDED), with the same prompt and tool access as S
L.role: fixed external reference control across all studies (continuity with QA-1, QA-2D and S1)

applied.what: EVAL-002: a T-shaped episode with LearningHook(apply=True). Verified, applicable discoveries from OTHER tasks are shown as the brief (at most 3), and RETRIEVAL and APPLICATION are recorded
applied.driver: runners/fs_org_driver.py run_pair(..., ledger, tag): applied arm

control.what: EVAL-002: the same task, workers and protocol, LearningHook(apply=False), no brief

compute_matching.unit: provider calls (PlumMe receipts: provider_attempt_count, at least 1) and recorded input+output tokens
compute_matching.rule_calls: E uses exactly T's call count on the same task (k as above)
compute_matching.rule_tokens: E's per-call max_output_tokens equals T's. E's total tokens must be within +-10% of T's on that task (the N rule of evidence/ogi013-lead/PREREG.md). Rows outside the band are kept, flagged COMPUTE_MISMATCH, and removed only in a labelled sensitivity analysis
compute_matching.order: T first on every task. E's budget is derived from T's receipts and is never tuned on outcomes
compute_matching.S_L: not compute-matched by design (they are the single-model references). Tokens and calls are reported per arm
compute_matching.applied_vs_control: identical episode caps. The brief's tokens are counted in the applied arm

secondary: D1 (needs a tau2 adapter in runners/fs_runtime.py)

EVAL-003.phase_1: S_luna and S_member_2, r = 3 independent attempts each, on every pool task
